purpose: The user asks to emphasise skills the candidate really has (incident response and SLOs).
correct_behaviour: Incident response and SLO work get more weight using only facts from the candidate's material.

requests.text: Please give more weight to my incident-response and SLO work - put it in the summary and near the top of my current role.
requests.correct_behaviour: The final CV mentions incident response and SLOs in the summary and early in the current role, with no new numbers or claims.
